description: This PHP source file defines the class dUnzip2, which provides functionality for reading, listing, and extracting contents from ZIP archives. It includes methods for loading file lists from ZIP files, extracting specific files, and handling various ZIP formats and compression methods.

classes.name: dUnzip2
classes.description: A class providing methods to read and extract files from ZIP archives, supporting multiple compression methods and detailed ZIP structure parsing.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the dUnzip2 class.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Loads and returns a list of files contained in the ZIP archive.

methods.name: getExtraInfo
methods.description: Returns detailed information about a specific file in the archive.

methods.name: getZipInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the ZIP archive's central directory.

methods.name: unzip
methods.description: Extracts a specified file from the ZIP archive to a target location.

methods.name: unzipAll
methods.description: Extracts all files from the ZIP archive into a specified directory.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the file handler associated with the ZIP archive.

methods.name: uncompress
methods.description: Decompresses file content based on the compression method.

methods.name: debugMsg
methods.description: Outputs debug messages if debugging is enabled.

methods.name: _loadFileListByEOF
methods.description: Loads the file list from ZIP archive by reading its End of Central Directory record.

methods.name: _loadFileListBySignatures
methods.description: Attempts to load the file list by scanning for ZIP signatures in the file.

methods.name: _getFileHeaderInformation
methods.description: Extracts header information for a file entry in the ZIP archive.
